However, the spec `it "is 404 without an embed_url"` only asserts `response.should_not be_success` (no status code expectation), so it does not actually pin 404 behavior—only non-success. The finding’s claim that the test’s “pinned behavior” mismatches is therefore overstated; at most it’s a minor description/naming nit in the test.
